authoring_method: Questions and evidence links were written manually from the frozen canonical units of the source document, before any output of the new chunking work existed. Design fixes the known weaknesses of the v1 set: multi-unit evidence is used wherever the answer genuinely spans units, no canonical unit backs more than two questions, and page coverage is spread across the document. Every expected answer is machine-checked to appear literally in its evidence text. Caveat: the author had previously inspected v1 retrieval results on this document, so questions were sampled systematically by page band rather than drawn from known failure cases.
